description: Temporary endpoint containment. Blocks GET requests to the documented vulnerable operation at /admin/API/mnt/Session/ActiveList.
affected_versions: Cisco Cisco Identity Services Engine Software: 3.1.0 p8, 3.1.0 p9, 3.3 Patch 2, 3.3 Patch 1, 3.3 Patch 3, 3.4.0, 3.2.0 p7, 3.3 Patch 4, 3.4 Patch 1, 3.1.0 p10, 3.3 Patch 5, 3.3 Patch 6, 3.4 Patch 2, 3.3 Patch 7, 3.4 Patch 3, 3.5.0, 3.4 Patch 4, 3.3 Patch 8, 3.2 Patch 8, 3.5 Patch 1, 3.3 Patch 9, 3.2 Patch 9, 3.4 Patch 5, 3.5 Patch 3, 3.5 Patch 2, 3.3 Patch 10, 3.3 Patch 11, 3.4 Patch 6, 3.2 Patch 10, 3.1.0 p11; Cisco Cisco ISE Passive Identity Connector: 3.4.0, 3.5.0; verify complete affected/fixed ranges and deployment prerequisites in the linked CNA/vendor records.
coverage: Blocks GET requests to the documented vulnerable operation at /admin/API/mnt/Session/ActiveList.
limitations: The body or authentication mechanism is not inspected; disabling this delivery endpoint is not exploit detection. Only the declared request facts and bounded native matcher are covered. No vulnerable-deployment reproduction was performed. Direct-origin access, alternate routes/encodings and uninspectable facts remain outside this rule. Apply vendor fixes; this is not complete CVE protection.
false_positive_risk: Blocks legitimate uses of this operation too. This is a temporary containment option for policies that can disable the operation; review application compatibility before enabling.
